summary: Iteration 61 — validated the three launch-mode enhancements on top of iter60: (1) Wall NEW ribbon, (2) Recovery Analytics + server-side funnel events, (3) Play-screenshot script output. 38/38 backend pytest cases pass — 14 new (test_recovery_analytics.py) + 24 regression across test_nickname_recovery.py + test_nickname_recovery_rate_limit.py. Public /api/community/recovery/track accepts only {magic_link_opened, manual_entry_opened}; email_sent/verify_success/verify_failed correctly rejected with 400. GET /api/community/recovery/analytics is 401 without X-Admin-Token, returns full field set with valid token, respects days= window, and magic_link_share math checks out (rounded to 3, 0.0 when no opens). Server-side funnel confirmed: request against claimed nickname → +1 email_sent; wrong verify → +1 verify_failed; correct planted-hash verify → +1 verify_success. Frontend: on /contributors both veggie_wizard and cook_ninja show `wall-new-badge-<nick>` amber 'New' ribbon, and the badges are freshness-based (still visible after switching to Recent sort). Opening NicknameRecoveryDialog from the Wall fires POST /api/community/recovery/track {event:'manual_entry_opened'} exactly once. Landing on /recover?n=veggie_wizard&c=123456 mounts the recovery dialog with prefill '123456' and fires magic_link_opened (see minor note about dev-mode StrictMode below). Screenshot script output at /app/frontend/public/screenshots/play/ all 8 PNGs are valid 1080x1920, 43-215 KB; 08-magic-link.png shows the recovery dialog (not the invalid explainer).

integration_issues.issue: In the preview env the funnel POST fires TWICE per /recover landing. Root cause is React 18 <React.StrictMode> double-invoking useEffect in dev mode (frontend is running `craco start`, not a production build). In a production build this effect runs once. The manual_entry_opened path only fired once in the same run because the effect depends on both isOpen and prefillCode and the dialog mount cycle wasn't StrictMode-doubled in that specific interaction. Not a code defect — inflation risk is only in dev. If concerned about matching the spec strictly ('exactly once per landing'), a ref-guard (`const fired = useRef(false)`) inside the effect would make it idempotent regardless of build mode.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add a useRef-guarded one-shot to RecoverLandingPage's magic_link_opened effect so counts are exact even under React.StrictMode dev double-invocation. Prod builds already fire once.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/community/recovery/track uses a raw Dict[str, Any] payload instead of the already-defined RecoveryEventRequest Pydantic model in models/analytics.py. Minor DRY/consistency nit — swapping to `payload: RecoveryEventRequest` would let FastAPI reject non-string events with a proper 422 and document the schema in OpenAPI.
_track_recovery swallows all insert errors with a bare except+log — good for best-effort funnel, but consider a Motor connection metric so silent DB outages aren't invisible.
ContributorWall.isFreshlyPromoted uses Date.now() and Date.parse — timezone-safe. Good.

RecoverLandingPage effect key is [valid] which is a memo; useEffect will re-run only when validity flips. Combined with StrictMode dev double-mount this fires twice in dev, once in prod. Consider ref-guard if you want deterministic counts in dev too.

recovery_events collection has no TTL index — long-lived funnel data will grow unbounded. If retention matters, add `db.recovery_events.createIndex({at:1}, {expireAfterSeconds: 60*60*24*90})` for a 90-day rolling window.
